name: Family Reunification Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Family members of Uzbekistan citizens, and partners/relatives of foreign nationals already holding temporary residence, may apply for a family-based residence permit. Spouses of citizens or residents can move to permanent residence after 5 years of marriage; guardians may register minor children under 18.
requirements.fix_path: Apply with proof of the family relationship and the sponsor's citizenship or valid residence status.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or proof of family relationship
Sponsor's proof of citizenship or valid residence status

outcome.duration_length: variable; spouses can reach permanent residence after 5 years of marriage

sources.title: Direct US Immigration (private immigration-consultancy site) -- family reunification and marriage-based permanent residence categories, 5-year marriage-to-PR threshold
e-immigration.uz (private immigration-services site) -- corroborates family-reunification and marriage-based permanent-residence categories and the 5-year threshold

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Uzbekistan). STATUS: DRAFT -- both sources are tier-4 private immigration-consultancy sites; no Ministry of Internal Affairs/migration-agency government portal for this specific route was locatable/fetchable in this build, and both source pages were themselves described by the fetch tool as incomplete (referencing document checklists not actually listed). This route is modeled thinly as a result -- treat duration, exact documentary requirements, and work-rights details as indicative rather than confirmed. leads_to_pr/pr_after_months reflect the 5-year marriage-to-permanent-residence pathway both sources describe, distinct from Uzbekistan's general 5-year naturalization residency clock (see uz_citizenship_naturalisation.json) -- these are two different clocks measuring different things (residence permit upgrade vs. citizenship), not asserted as the same requirement.
